title: Dots now stay vertically centered, class card borders doubled
summary: Colored dots next to titles (Upcoming Events, Due Soon, class hover popups, calendar search results, etc.) were nudged down with a fixed margin that only lined up correctly for items with exactly the 'usual' number of text lines -- they now use proper flex centering everywhere, so they stay lined up with the middle of the text regardless of how many lines it wraps to.
Class card borders are now 2x their previous width for more definition.
